notice: All organizations, account facts, activity and results are synthetic. These are proposed GTM workflows, not deployed employer systems or measured company performance.
title: A handoff the next team can actually use.
intro: A proposed workbench for Pigment’s 70% internal AI and 30% pipeline remit: make AE-to-CS handoffs complete, then connect adoption and market experiments to outcomes.
queueIntro: A closed deal is not a complete implementation brief. Keep the customer’s planning outcome, data ownership and sales commitments attached to the handoff.
workbenchIntro: Change the handoff inputs or test an expansion hypothesis. Usage is context; a new business need and an accountable owner are still required.
firstBody: Give the receiving team the planning use case, named customer data owner, promised scope and agreed success measure. Measure acceptance and repeat use of the internal workflow.

metricsTitle: Measure internal adoption alongside qualified pipeline.
metricsIntro: Illustrative weekly product-use data and a fixed North American account cohort. Product adoption and pipeline creation remain separate measures.
metricsNotes: Weekly active users / eligible users measures reach; repeat users / active users measures repeat use.
Accepted handoffs / proposed handoffs measures the receiving team’s response, not customer success.
Campaign spend / qualified opportunities is a pipeline efficiency indicator. It is not customer acquisition cost without acquired customers and complete costs.

experiments.name: Structured AE-to-CS brief
experiments.hypothesis: Explicit customer outcomes and commitments reduce returned handoffs.
experiments.guardrail: Missing commitments and time spent reviewing
experiments.allocation: Assign matched accounts to one variant for a fixed observation window; review uncertainty before expansion.

experiments.name: NA planning trigger
experiments.hypothesis: A specific planning change helps sellers prepare relevant discovery.
experiments.treatment: Reviewed planning trigger and use-case question
experiments.allocation: Assign matched accounts to one variant for a fixed observation window; review uncertainty before expansion.

roadmap.title: Discover the internal product
roadmap.body: Observe AE and CS handoffs. Choose one repeated failure and define acceptance with the receiving team.
roadmap.measure: Return reasons, baseline review time and eligible users

roadmap.title: Ship and observe adoption
roadmap.body: Pilot the brief, collect corrections and keep AI-generated suggestions reviewable. Run one small NA campaign.
roadmap.measure: Weekly and repeat use, qualified pipeline and opt-outs

roadmap.title: Improve from real outcomes
roadmap.body: Refine internal workflows using adoption evidence and customer outcomes. Expand only experiments that survive a useful observation window.
roadmap.measure: Workflow retention, rework and qualified pipeline influence

aiApplication: At Pigment, I would apply MCP tool-use experience and bounded agent orchestration to the AE-to-CS handoff: verify planning context, data owner, promised scope and success measure. An adoption loop would track reviewer acceptance and repeat use before broader rollout.
